prompt.zh-TW: 晨光補習班用現金 {{money:vars.price}} 買了一批可以用四年的教室桌椅。這個月的損益表上，這筆錢怎麼呈現？
prompt.en: Morning Light Tutoring pays {{money:vars.price}} in cash for classroom desks and chairs that will last four years. How does this money appear on this month’s income statement?

text.zh-TW: 不會整筆出現；桌椅記成資產，之後每期只提列一小部分折舊費用
text.en: Not as a whole; the furniture is recorded as an asset, and only a small depreciation expense appears each period

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。能用四年的東西，成本要分攤到四年，而不是一次扣光。
feedback.en: Nice work. Something that lasts four years has its cost spread over four years rather than deducted all at once.

text.zh-TW: 整筆 {{money:vars.price}} 列為這個月的費用
text.en: The full {{money:vars.price}} is this month’s expense

feedback.zh-TW: 錢確實是這個月付的，這點沒錯。但桌椅這個月只用了一點點；整筆當費用會讓這個月看起來大虧、之後三年多卻免費用桌椅，不合理。
feedback.en: The cash was indeed paid this month, that much is right. But the furniture was only used a little this month; expensing it all would make this month look like a big loss and the next three years look free, which is not reasonable.

text.zh-TW: 列為營業成本，因為是為了上課才買的
text.en: As cost of sales, because it was bought for teaching

feedback.zh-TW: 桌椅確實是為了上課才買的，這點沒錯。但營業成本是賣出商品本身的成本；桌椅不是拿來賣的，而是拿來用好幾年的設備。
feedback.en: The furniture was indeed bought for teaching, that much is right. But cost of sales is the cost of goods that were sold; the furniture is not for sale but equipment to be used for years.

explanation.zh-TW: 會用很多年的東西是資產，成本透過折舊分期變成費用，所以{{option:o_skvz}}正確。{{option:o_khpa}}把付現的時點當成費用的時點；{{option:o_m9dh}}混淆了設備和商品。
explanation.en: Something used over many years is an asset, and its cost becomes an expense gradually through depreciation, so {{option:o_skvz}} is right. {{option:o_khpa}} uses the moment of payment as the moment of expense, and {{option:o_m9dh}} confuses equipment with goods for sale.
